title: One writer core serves parity and requirement backlogs, found through a registry
outcome: Any registered programme is ingested through one profiled writer core, and every command finds it by registry key.
why: alpha--second and alpha--third are the same seam: a writer generalised to serve any programme, and a registry that finds it without a ticket-shaped run id.

combination.why: Both atoms land in the same writer-core change; splitting them would ship half a seam.
